name: Rizoba Report ~Ritou no Ryokan de Resort Baito!~
original_name: りぞばレポート～離島の旅館でリゾートバイト！～
source:
Every summer the protagonist fails to make any lasting memories, so he decides to do part-time at a resort inn in the Tropics in order to find love.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/22/kuzumushi%E2%99%A5/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
每到夏天，主人公总是没能留下任何难忘的回忆。为了寻找恋情，他决定前往南国离岛，在一家度假旅馆打工。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/12/22/kuzumushi%E2%99%A5/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
